prior.representation: continuous initial log-K law with every body-ratio factor and Keep/Reset logsumexp recurrence
prior.normalization_definition: mass of the retained continuous recurrence; local evidence estimates set branch-relative scales only

properness.proof: bounded positive full-joint body ratio factors and finite branch-relative scales; no claim of exact Laplace normalization

bayes_factor_surprise.representation: continuous factor/Keep-Reset logsumexp recurrence; no stiffness moment projection

prior_source.bounds_role: initial Gaussian construction only; log K support is unbounded

auxiliary_model.declaration: Generated shared robot URDF, including its supplied masses/inertias and known tool/camera attachments, with deflecomp gravity and linear joint spring law. These are inputs of the auxiliary model, not quantities learned from observations. The simulator's true stiffness and realized pose are excluded.
auxiliary_model.active_joint_limit_policy: actual box boundary and outward KKT sign; zero proximity/sign tolerance; converged interior roots stay free
auxiliary_model.equilibrium: existing EquilibriumSolver stiffness-homotopy continuation; initialized at sent command, not physical truth

global_convexity_certificate.proof: URDF mass-times-gravity times rotated-segment lengths bound every gravity Hessian entry; exact gravity-parallel root rotation symmetry gives zero rows; positive weighted row witness certifies diag(K)-B positive definite
global_convexity_certificate.uncertified_policy: retain canonical continuation; no candidate or update dropped
global_convexity_certificate.finite_direct_root_policy: use only after the existing 1e-11 Nm exact-box KKT residual target; otherwise canonical continuation

stiffness.approximation: specified Bingham-derived local Gaussian body proxies; no Gaussian projection of cumulative stiffness density

body_internal_approximation.approximation: single internal common-chart joint Gaussian by analytic mixture moments; existing first-order Bingham reexpression once
body_internal_approximation.ratio_semantics: prior versus the declared full joint moment approximation after sensor fusion; not the unprojected exact observation likelihood

body_marginal.chart_measure: common Haar rotation volume and parent-translation Lebesgue volume; single-chart Jacobian cancels
body_marginal.nuisance_policy: unknown marker and other variables integrated out by Gaussian marginal extraction
body_marginal.numerator_semantics: actual frozen globally weighted posterior children

auxiliary_numerical_diagnostics.policy: finite residual, curvature and iteration audits are diagnostic only; actual nonfinite arithmetic or unsolved linear systems remain errors

retained_prior.representation: continuous initial log-K law with every body-ratio factor and Keep/Reset logsumexp recurrence
retained_prior.normalization_definition: mass of the retained continuous recurrence; local evidence estimates set branch-relative scales only

properness.proof: bounded positive full-joint body ratio factors and finite branch-relative scales; no claim of exact Laplace normalization

bayes_factor_surprise.representation: continuous factor/Keep-Reset logsumexp recurrence; no stiffness moment projection

transition.reset_kernel: independent redraw of the supplied command-dependent body law; retain the environment marginal
transition.reset_body_environment_cross_covariance: zero by the specified independent redraw kernel

command_path.ledger_reference_validation: schema, range and endpoint validated locally; chain digests are supplied by the append-only ledger owner, not recomputed by replaying every historical record
command_path.covariance_action: G P G.T on the full joint state, G=diag(I,D_j.T); environmental block is identity
command_path.composition: ordered recorded increments about each declared fixed joint axis, summed per joint

finite_difference_diagnostics.log_difference_arithmetic: compensated common-scale subtraction; native log weights added after density-scale subtraction

selection_factors.view_gradient_definition: unweighted dV/dc; None when inactive or unavailable

tolerance_basis.angular_domain: marker center direction only; no board-corner or detection guarantee
tolerance_basis.default_angle_rationale: 10 degrees lies inside the 26.565 degree minimum half field of view of the declared 960x720, focal=720 camera

local_model_diagnostics.approximation: responsibility-weighted complete-component Fisher; Gaussian position and Bingham-derived concentrated quaternion tangent Gaussian; view residual Gauss-Newton
local_model_diagnostics.regularization_role: declared local model only; not candidate covariance, K or control gain
